bibl.title: Le lettere di B.P. Grenfell a J.G. Smyly del 1899 e del 1900.
bibl.seg: 160 Grenfell Bernard Pyne Smyly Josiah Gilbart
Natascia Pellé, Le lettere di B.P. Grenfell a J.G. Smyly del 1899 e del 1900.
bibl.note: Critical edition of letters that Grenfell sent to Smyly in 1899 and 1900. It includes four documents related to the second volume of POxy, an initial selection of papyri from Tebtynis, and the first volume of PAmherst, which mentions the consistency of the second one.
